blocks.text: Model ke output ko samajhne ka matlab hai jaanna ke nataij kya batate hain aur nateeja nikalna. Agar regression dikhaye ke parhai ke ghante exam scores par gehra asar dalte hain to hum nateeja nikal sakte hain ke zyada ghante parhna students ko behtar banane mein madad dega.

blocks.prompt: Stall model mein 40 ka slope maalik ko kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Har izafi customer taqreeban 40 rupay barhata hai, to zyada customers lana kamai barhane ka bunyadi tareeqa hai.

items: Output samajhna: model ke nataij ko nateejon mein badalna (zyada parhai, zyada scores).
